selected.backend_scope: middle: one authored API and one complete lesson

explanation: Firebase hosts its managed services on Google infrastructure. Supabase similarly hosts Postgres/Auth/Storage. An authored NestJS API needs a runtime, initially the developer PC and later a cloud service. Supabase Edge Functions are an alternative implementation that runs authored TypeScript/Deno functions inside Supabase; a separate hosting provider is not inherent to PostgreSQL.
